## What

Ten back-to-back passes, plus pulling the USB camera cable mid-pass.

## Done when

- [ ] No data loss across the 10 passes.
- [ ] The cable pull is recovered from without a reboot, and the pass that was
      interrupted is reported as such rather than silently truncated.
